PROP-e5782b58-pre-019.text: Discord membership verification must be checked on every login, not cached from prior sessions.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-019.assertion: forall login(user): discord_guild_check(user.discord_id) called at auth time, not from cache

locations.note: Discord membership is checked via fetch with cache: 'no-store' (line 26), ensuring fresh data on every dashboard page load. This check gates access to the dashboard (lines 96-131) but is NOT checked at the auth callback — only when the dashboard is rendered.
If is_in_server == false or hasLinkedRole == false, user is shown a gate screen instead of the dashboard. Checked server-side on every render.
